## Context

The next Quarto release changes how the Typst output is built.
Every document of the team must render again before the end of the month.

## Decision

We move all documents to the new release in one batch.
The old release stays available for two weeks.

## Next steps

Each owner renders their documents and reports any difference on the team channel.
